For every strict-seam mutation, prove the legacy oracle would not distinguish the forged call while the new assertion would fail; do not modify verifier behavior to manufacture RED.
green: All valid bootstrap, scope-action, and replay-pre-final tuples pass the strict complete-call oracle with exactly eight logical signed-slot calls (bootstrap expects the root PIS twice).

Every signed slot's forged signature refuses; bootstrap mutates its equal root/phase bytes together, while scope-action and replay-pre-final mutate each of their eight supplied signed slots independently.

Focused preflight, capture-lifecycle, trust, purity, and ruff checks pass; a no-effect sentinel proves valid and refusal paths do not enter capture, lifecycle, session, WORM, resolver, import, construction, execution, or admission-consumption routes.

required_test_approach: Replace the permissive _Keyring success oracle with a strict ReleaseKeyring subclass that independently derives an ordered expected queue from the raw test envelopes and compares all five arguments: key_id, key_version, issued_at_ms, canonical envelope preimage with only named self and signature removed, and signature.

Make the synthetic signature deterministically depend on that independently constructed preimage; do not call verifier private helpers. Assert the complete ordered queue, not merely its length, for all three profiles and all eight logical slots.

Add direct signature and preimage sensitivity rows across the complete slot/profile family, including the bootstrap duplicate root-PIS call. The strict oracle must reject argument reordering, changed key/version/issued time, changed preimage, and changed signature.

Replace revocation count-only coverage with an ordered expected four-argument queue (snapshot_sha256, key_id, key_version, one shared now_ms); retain exactly-one clock read and assert identity for each profile.
Exercise false, non-bool, and exception outcomes for both public seams at every logical signed slot across profiles, with the strict expected calls preserved through the refusal point.

Add explicit no-effect sentinels for the forbidden public capture/lifecycle/session/WORM/resolver/import/construction/execution/consumption surfaces and assert zero calls on one valid and representative signature/refusal paths.
